summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing for Telugu POS 'ఉష కిరాణా' with new JWT auth layer. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (auth 401 for unauth, wrong-pw 401 Telugu msg, /auth/me, bearer works, seed+items, customers, bulk-price dry-run+apply, cash bill, khata bill+settlement, daily report, settings CRUD without GSTIN). Frontend: login gate, wrong-pw error, correct-login → POS shell, logout, POS '/' hotkey, cat filter chips, code shortcut b2 Enter, b1*3 qty, discount, cash bill save + window.print override, receipt contains 'ఉష కిరాణా' + 'ఇది అంచనా బిల్లు మాత్రమే' + no 'GSTIN', khata bill with customer select, bulk import (space/comma/= all parse), khata settlement reduces balance and appears in ledger, history date-range+search+detail+reprint, report cards (cash/UPI/card/khata), settings save with NO GSTIN field, address transliteration works (preview 'మైన్ రోడ్'), and mobile 390x844 for all 7 pages (no horizontal overflow). Found 1 medium UI bug on Items page and 1 potential race on QuickRate one-shot.

ui_bugs.issue: Row price input uses defaultValue={it.price} (uncontrolled). After QuickRate or bulk-import updates the price, the DB is correct but the visible input keeps the stale value until page reload. Confirmed: toast said 'b2: ₹172 → ₹168' & backend returned 168, but item-price-b2 input still displayed 172.

One-shot form (e.g. typing 'b2 199' in quick-rate-code and pressing Enter) intermittently shows toast 'కోడ్ కనబడలేదు' even though the code exists. The two-step flow (code Enter → price Enter) always works. Likely stale-closure: onKeyDown reads `code` from state that hasn't flushed yet after the last onChange, so apply() splits an old value. Repro: on freshly loaded /items, type 'b2 199' and press Enter in the code box.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by emergent instrumentation wrapping option text — same as iteration 1; not user-fixable.

action_items: Items.jsx: switch item-price-<code> to controlled input (value={row.price} with per-row local state) OR force remount with key={`${it.id}-${it.price}`} so quick-rate/bulk-import price updates reflect in the row immediately.

Items.jsx QuickRate: fix stale-closure in apply(). Two options: (a) read the value directly from codeRef.current.value inside apply(); or (b) use a ref that mirrors `code` state; or (c) call apply() after a microtask so React has flushed state. Otherwise one-shot 'b2 199' + Enter can fail intermittently with 'కోడ్ కనబడలేదు'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `list_bills` date range still uses tz-less string boundaries against tz-aware ISO strings — small edge risk around midnight UTC (unchanged from iteration 1).

auth.jsx: raw admin token stored in localStorage AND set as default axios header. Since backend also sets an httpOnly cookie, dropping localStorage would be more secure — but the current dual-mode is required because the browser cookie is SameSite=None+Secure and cross-site XHR requires credentials; leaving as-is is acceptable.

Login flow: brute-force lockout uses `request.client.host` + email; behind a proxy this is the proxy IP so effectively per-account lockout. Acceptable, but note that a shared kiosk pattern (this app is single admin) is fine.
Items.jsx savePrice ignores errors — a failed PUT would silently show a success toast. Wrap in try/catch.
Billing.jsx `save()` awaits `api.customers()` between resetting lines and calling window.print(); if the customers call is slow the print delay drifts. Consider printing before refetching customers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed flows, with 2 medium bugs on Items page (data still persists correctly)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed is called at start of pytest session; frontend Billing page also auto-seeds on mount.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (13 tests, includes Auth/Settings). It uses env var REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — export it before running. For frontend automation: (1) ALWAYS add init script overriding window.print (Billing/History/Report trigger it). (2) Log in first via [data-testid=login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn]. (3) Bearer token also accepted for backend calls if you need to seed/verify from python side. (4) Customer list buttons use data-testid=customer-<uuid> — do NOT use ^='customer-' prefix selector because customer-name-input on the same page also starts with that. (5) Bill numbers cumulate across runs; recent state: rameష్ గారు balance ~₹1,211 after this iteration.
